title: Dorman  76992 OER Chrome Interior Door Handle for IHC Trucks 862106R2
description_markdown: Authentic Dorman/Help part 76992. New Old Stock factory hardware, precision inspected and ready to ship.

fitments.notes: 76992 interlor door handle. International Harvester. * Door Hinge Pin and Bushing Kits Replaces worn sticking hinge pins and bushings for smoother, even door operation. Worn or damaged hinge pins cause door to rub or scrape fender or trim and will not line up with latch. Test by opening door and noting If It drops down. Pull up on door at point farthest vom bushing and note looseness. Pins made of high tensile strength eel.
